name: vocapi
description: Save vocabulary from your conversation as flashcards in Vocapi.

interface.longDescription: Vocapi helps you turn words and phrases from your current conversation into vocabulary flashcards. Review a checklist before saving, choose an existing playlist or create a new one, and see your playlists and card counts. A Vocapi account is required.
defaultPrompt: Save the new words from this conversation to Vocapi
Add these phrases to my Vocapi playlist
Which of these words are already in Vocapi?
